name: Entity Webhook Broadcast
description: Submodule of Entity Webhook. Sends outbound webhooks when entities are created, updated, or deleted: matches entity CRUD events to configured outbound endpoints (with Condition API filtering), builds a JSON payload from entity fields via outbound value resolvers, HMAC-signs and POSTs it through a queue, retries failed deliveries with exponential backoff, and records every attempt in an OutboundDeliveryLog.
project_description: Entity Webhook Broadcast is the outbound submodule of Entity Webhook. It watches entity create, update, and delete events on any configured entity type and bundle and sends an outbound webhook for each matching event. Endpoints can filter events with Drupal's Condition API (for example, only published nodes). Each endpoint has one or more subscriptions, and each subscription defines a destination URL, an optional HMAC shared secret and signing algorithm, and retry settings (max attempts and base delay). Payloads are built from OutboundFieldMapping children via outbound value resolvers (entity field, entity reference field, field component, static value) with optional field-value mutations reused from the parent module, then delivered through a queue with the Guzzle HTTP client. Failed deliveries are retried on cron with exponential backoff until success or the attempt cap, and every attempt is recorded as an OutboundDeliveryLog content entity for auditing. Requires the entity_webhook parent module. Maintained by Travis Tomka (droath).
